# Mortgage Equity Partners

> > Mortgage Equity Partners is a multi-state mortgage lender offering conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and jumbo loans with specialized programs for first responders and home buyers across 15+ states.

Mortgage Equity Partners (MEP) provides residential mortgage lending services with a team of senior loan officers and specialized programs including bridge loans, down payment assistance, and first responder benefits. Licensed across Alabama, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and other states.

## Key Topics

- Mortgage Equity Partners
- NMLS compliance
- Conventional loans
- FHA loans
- VA loans
- USDA loans
- Jumbo loans
- Bridge loans
- First responders program
- Down payment assistance
- Multi-state lending
- Senior loan officers
- Home purchase financing
- Refinancing services
- Appraisal processing

## Loan Programs & Services

- [First Responders Program @MEP](https://mortgageequitypartners.com/first-responders-program): First Responders Program: $500 closing cost credit for purchase/refinance
- [How to use a bridge loan to buy a home](https://mortgageequitypartners.com/how-to-use-a-bridge-loan-to-buy-a-home): Guide to using bridge loans leveraging home equity for new purchases
- [Delaware State Housing Authority down payment assistance](https://mortgageequitypartners.com/delaware-state-housing-authority-down-payment-assistance): Delaware State Housing Authority down payment assistance programs guide
